notes.title: Improved Tutorial & Endless Replayability Fest
notes.content: Hello, fellow sheep! We appreciate all the feedback you've provided. We've enhanced the tutorial to ensure a smoother experience, guiding you in constructing a sturdy home for our adorable lamb babies. Additionally, we're excited to announce our participation in the Endless Replayability Fest, running from May 13th to 20th. Together, let's fend off the wolves and safeguard our sanctuary!

notes.title: SINGLE PLAYER DEMO IS OUT!
notes.content: Hey everyone! Guess what? The single-player demo for BAA! Never Stop Bleating is out now! You can dive into this cool game where you're a sheep trying to build a safe home in the forest for your little ones. There are scary beasts and lots of challenges, but it's super fun. Give it a try and see if you can keep your sheep family safe! 🐑🏠

notes.title: Beta Playtest Phase 2 Complete!
notes.content: Last week, we launched Phase 2 of the beta playtest, which was improved by your feedback in the Phase 1 beta. Thanks to all of you for engaging in the playtest. We sincerely appreciate all of your valuable feedback. With your input in mind, we are committed to further improving the game and ensuring that the adorable sheep babies can live even longer! The current phase of the beta will be closing in three days. If you'd like to experience the gameplay early, wishlist and request access to the next phase of the beta playtest now!

notes.title: Beta Phase 2 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We are thrilled to announce that the beta phase 2 of our game testing is officially underway! Building on the valuable feedback from our last beta phase, we have made significant improvements across the board and added exciting new elements. We hope you thoroughly enjoy this enhanced gaming experience! Get ready for an adventure like no other!

notes.title: Beta Playtest Phase 1 Complete! Here's What's Next!
notes.content: Last week, we launched Phase 1 of the beta playtest to evaluate the core gameplay. We deeply appreciate all of your valuable feedback. With your input in mind, we are committed to further improving the game and ensuring that the adorable sheep babies can live even longer! The current phase of beta playtest will be closing in one day. If you'd like to experience the gameplay early, wishlist and request access to the next phase of the beta playtest now!

notes.title: BETA Playtest Now Live – Join the Action!
notes.content:
Calling all adventurers! Join our beta playtest today and be among the first to experience the thrilling gameplay of "BAA! Never Stop Bleating."
